plate_chain: original BGR -> top-left cv2 letterbox960 -> internal Torch bilinear640 align_corners=False -> decoded xywh*1.5; IDENTICAL during training/validation/export/app
scheduler: 3epoch linear warmup from10%, then cosine to5%; global gradient clipping10
augmentation: 50% GT-centred zoom; include every intersecting valid GT clipped to crop. Smaller face inverse-size sampling. HSV+hflip. Final5epochs no augmentation. No mosaic shrinking tiny faces.
confidence_selection: merged validation only; maximize min-class recall if95%not met, otherwise precision; unchanged target
test_policy: New400source test frozen before fitting. All prior TEST used for regression only, never fitting/selection. Final candidate and baseline each evaluated once on same newtest after checkpoint+confidence frozen.
